title: Top Pressure Washers for Driveways & Decks (2026)
summary: Top pressure washers for driveways and decks in 2026 are chosen from expert reviews.
method: Selected products that appear in at least two of the cited sources (Consumer Reports, TechGearLab, Car & Driver, Popular Mechanics, BobVila).
assumptions: Prices are not provided in the sources, so no price information is included.

products.name: Westinghouse WPX3200
why: The Westinghouse WPX3200 was identified by TechGearLab as the best of the best for its unmatched cleaning performance.
Consumer Reports lists it among the top gas pressure washers tested for driveway and deck cleaning.
products.desc: The Westinghouse WPX3200 is a gas‑powered pressure washer that delivers high pressure for deep cleaning of driveways and decks. It does not include a battery or electric motor.
products.benefit: Picture a homeowner standing on a dusty driveway, using the WPX3200 to blast away years of grime. The washer’s high pressure removes stubborn stains quickly, saving time compared to manual scrubbing. It outperforms the other picks in this guide because it has the highest cleaning power, the only gas model, and the longest run time for heavy jobs. The catch: it is heavier and louder than electric alternatives.
products.best_for: Homeowners needing powerful cleaning for large outdoor areas
products.skip_if: You prefer a quiet, lightweight electric model
products.amazon_listing: Westinghouse WPX3200 Gas Pressure Washer, 3200 PSI and 2.5 GPM, Onboard Soap Tank, Spray G

products.name: Ego Power+ HPW3204-2
why: BobVila selected the Ego Power+ HPW3204-2 as its Upgrade Pick for impressive cleaning power and user‑friendly features.
TechGearLab noted the LWQ S5 as a top electric model, but Ego offers higher power in a battery‑powered format.
products.desc: The Ego Power+ HPW3204-2 is a battery‑powered electric pressure washer that provides strong cleaning power for driveways and decks. It does not use gas or a cord.
products.benefit: Picture a homeowner using the Ego Power+ to clean a deck without the hassle of a power cord. The battery gives freedom of movement and the high pressure removes tough stains efficiently. It beats the other electric picks because it offers the highest power among battery models and is more portable than the LWQ S5. The catch: its battery life is limited during extended use.
pros: High power for a battery model
products.best_for: Users who want a powerful, cordless washer for outdoor cleaning
products.skip_if: You need continuous, long‑haul power without recharging
products.amazon_listing: EGO POWER+ Electric Pressure Washer Kit, 3200 PSI Power Washer - HPW3204-2

products.name: Ryobi Electric Pressure Washer
why: Car & Driver listed the Ryobi Electric as the best compact pressure washer.
It is suitable for small driveways and decks.
products.desc: The Ryobi Electric Pressure Washer is a compact electric unit that cleans driveways and decks efficiently. It does not use gas or a battery.
products.benefit: Picture a homeowner cleaning a small deck with the Ryobi, enjoying its lightweight design and easy maneuverability. It offers sufficient pressure for light to moderate cleaning and is more portable than larger electric models. It wins in compactness but has lower pressure than the Greenworks. The catch: it lacks built‑in soaping and has a shorter run time.
products.best_for: Users who need a lightweight, easy‑to‑handle washer for small areas
products.skip_if: You need high pressure or built‑in soap

verdict.line: The Westinghouse WPX3200 is ideal for homeowners who need a powerful, gas‑powered washer that can tackle heavy grime on driveways and decks. It delivers the highest cleaning power in the guide, but it is heavier and louder than the electric models.
